workbench.title: Template Management
workbench.body: Create and import templates; organize them with search and groups; open the designer or print right from a card.

designer.title: The Label Design Canvas
designer.body: Drag in text, barcode and QR code elements to compose a label; bind print fields; preview at real print scale.

data.title: Fill Data & Print
data.body: Pick a template to get its fill-in form; preview the label image before a test print; batch print by importing Excel data.

jobs.title: Print Job Records
jobs.body: Browse the last 100 print jobs; expand a job for per-label results; find failure reasons when a print goes wrong.

settings.title: Settings for This Machine
settings.body: Set the server address (shared templates) and printers; check status, send a test page; update language, client and plugins.

intro.title: Build One Yourself
intro.body: All steps are real: drag widgets, set properties, bind fields, name and save; the demo creates "Sample · Basic Label".

draw.title: Drag Widgets In
draw.body: Drag "Text", "Barcode" and "QR code" from the left widget bar onto the canvas; smart guides snap as you move, Ctrl+Z to undo.

props.title: Tune the Properties
props.body: Select an element on the canvas and tune its font, font height and barcode parameters on the right.

fields.title: Make Content Follow Data
fields.body: Pick "Field fill" and name the field (e.g. product name); data fills it at print time. The left "Print Fields" list is automatic.

name.title: Name It and Save
name.body: Type a name in the top toolbar and click "Save Template"; it returns to the Workbench, where you can find it by name.

outro.title: Demo Complete
outro.body: The sample is cleaned up by default; check "Keep sample" to keep practicing. Come back any time via "Demo" in the page header.

intro.title: Create, Export, Import
intro.body: A real walk-through: create a template, export it to a file, import it back, then find it by name.

new.title: Create a New Template
new.body: Click "New Template" to open the designer; the demo follows and builds the "Sample · Basic Label" template with sample elements.

export.title: Export It to a File
export.body: On the template card, open "…" and choose "Export" to download a .lfpkg package; you import it back in the next step.

import.title: Import It Back
import.body: Click "Import Template" and pick the .lfpkg you just downloaded; the same template reappears in the list with contents intact.

identify.title: Know It by Name
identify.body: Templates are distinguished by name: the list sorts by name and group; type a name in the search box to locate one quickly.

outro.title: Demo Complete
outro.body: The sample template is cleaned up by default; check "Keep sample" to keep practicing.

form.title: Fields Become a Form
form.body: Pick the sample template; the "Product Name" and "Code" fields you just bound are filled in here.

excel.title: Fields Are Excel Columns
excel.body: Click "Download Excel Template", one row per label; confirm each column's field on import to batch print (demo prints nothing).

residue.title: Sample Templates Found
residue.body: The last demo was interrupted and left sample templates behind.
residue.bodyExtra: Clean them up now, keep them to practice, or choose "Not Now" to decide next time.
